# Theodore Savage

Theodore Savage is the Founder of The Cultivation Effect®, a leadership development framework and  
experiential platform designed to help individuals and organizations move beyond surface-level performance  
fixes and address the root systems that shape behavior, decision-making, and culture.

With over two decades of experience developing leaders across fitness, corporate, and educational  
environments, Theodore has worked at the intersection of human performance, leadership psychology, and  
organizational systems. His career has focused on helping leaders understand why they show up the way they  
do under pressure—and how to build environments, patterns, and standards that sustain clarity, alignment, and  
execution over time.

The Cultivation Effect® was born out of a simple but powerful insight: most leadership breakdowns are not skill  
problems—they are system problems. Rather than treating symptoms like burnout, disengagement, or attrition,  
Theodore’s work helps leaders identify the underlying conditions shaping their behavior and impact. The TCE  
framework is built around seven interconnected pillars—Environment, Patterns, Alignment, Execution, Culture,  
Resilience, and Presence—providing leaders with both diagnostic insight and practical tools they can apply  
immediately.

As a speaker and facilitator, Theodore is known for delivering experiences that are direct, grounded, and deeply  
human. His work resonates across audiences because it bridges personal accountability with systemic  
awareness—challenging leaders to take ownership without placing blame, and to lead with intention rather than  
reactivity. Over the years, his work and perspective have been featured across national and international  
platforms, including Good Morning America, Today Show, Good Day New York, Breakfast Television Toronto,  
along with countless regional media appearances and social podcasts such as BLKHLTH.

Today, his focus on helping leaders diagnose friction, align values with action, and build rhythms that hold under  
pressure — not through motivation, but through clarity. His keynotes and facilitated experiences are designed  
not as one-time moments of inspiration, but as catalysts for sustained growth and behavioral change.

In addition to speaking engagements and organizational partnerships, Theodore is the author of The Cultivation  
Effect Workbook, a guided leadership resource that helps individuals diagnose their leadership patterns, clarify  
alignment, and translate insight into action. The workbook and accompanying diagnostic tools are frequently  
used as pre- and post-event integration resources to extend impact beyond the room.

At the core of Theodore’s work is a belief that leadership is cultivated, not inherited—and that when leaders

learn to tend to the systems shaping their behavior, they unlock more consistent, resilient, and meaningful  
impact on the people they serve.

# Darren Willoughby

Darren K. Willoughby Jr. is a brand and business strategist with over a decade of experience helping companies find their voice, sharpen their message, and show up with intention. His background spans both financial services and creative strategy, giving him a perspective that is equal parts analytical and human. Through his work in branding and marketing, he has partnered with entrepreneurs, executives, and creative teams to build brands that actually connect with the people they are trying to reach. Darren believes that great branding is not about looking good on paper \-- it is about making people feel something and giving them a reason to stay. A Baltimore native, he brings the same authenticity and directness to every room he walks into. 

# Timothy Robertson

STATUS International is the holding company Timothy J. Robertson built to serve the lifestyle and business needs of high-profile CEOs, executives, and public figures. Everything under the umbrella is viewed through one lens: luxury, hospitality, and the art market, which behave as Veblen goods, appreciating in demand as price rises, the inverse of how standard goods behave. That thesis shapes every initiative STATUS runs.

**STATUS Branding** was the first. What began as design work for D.C.'s leading entrepreneurs became go to market strategy, brand positioning, and digital / in real life activations work with Visa, JP Morgan Chase, Amazon AWS Sports, NBC Universal, Xfinity, Rivian Automotive, and other high-profile brands. The work sits deliberately between two disciplines: brand positioning and strategy that create the conditions for multimillion dollar deals via verbal and visual messaging to high net worth audiences, that actually closes them. Timothy applies this both directly with clients and as the model his clients use to engage their own B2B audiences, aptly named the STATUS Brand Framework©. 

Timothy is now focused on global travel to activate his high net worth and investor network through in-person hospitality. He personally consults executives on gaining access into exclusive markets across France, Switzerland, Italy, and now the Middle East, opening doors through a decade of tenured relationships rather than cold entry. He spends a significant portion of his time in Paris and the South of France, where much of that network lives and convenes. That access was on display when Timothy privatized a yacht for AWS Sports, placing 40 of its executives in a single 72 meter yacht for 2 days with champagne and caviar to entertain clients and high net worth guests during Formula 1 Monaco Grand Prix weekend. When no one else could deliver, Amazon called Timothy directly, drawing on that same tenured network to execute a hospitality solution that was both high-profile and highly discreet. His work now continues by activating B2B brands and investor communities around the world's most recognizable events: Davos, Formula 1, Global Champions Showjumping, Wimbledon, Art Basel, and more.

Feel free to contact Timothy J. Robertson for recommendations on world events that can double your B2B efforts while enjoying the beauty of world travel.

# Tiffany Bethea

Once you encounter Tiffany Bethea, you will understand why her clients have been able to double revenue in just 30-60 days. Tiffany Bethea is an award-winning speaker, digital brand strategist, and bestselling author, and for the past 16 years, she has shown women coaches, speakers, and service providers how to launch massively profitable and impactful online brands. Tiffany is the Executive Director of the Baltimore City Chamber of Commerce. In this role, she oversees the Chamber’s strategic direction, builds high-impact partnerships, and advances programs that support business growth, leadership development, and community impact. 

# Keisha Bradley

Keisha Bradley is an award-winning strategic communications executive, entrepreneur, and nationally recognized speaker known for helping brands, organizations, and leaders turn their stories into influence. As CEO of The PR Alliance, she has led strategic communications efforts that have earned clients visibility in outlets including Forbes, ESSENCE, ABC, FOX, and Black Enterprise. Beyond the agency, she founded PRocon, a national community connecting public relations, marketing, media, and communications professionals, while her TEDx Talk on strategic communications has earned nearly 2 million views and is now used in communications classrooms across the United States. 

# Gilbryonna Shaw

**Gilbryonna Shaw** is the Founder of Nü Momish and Executive Director of Nü You Inc., a nonprofit dedicated to strengthening families by centering the wellness, growth, and connection of mothers. Known as the "Chief Momish Officer," Gilbryonna is building the village that mamas deserve — creating one of the safest communities and resource centers for moms navigating every stage of the motherhood journey, from preconception to empty-nesting.

Through Nü Momish, Gilbryonna provides mothers with easy access to essential resources and hosts monthly "Momish Meetups," safe spaces for moms to gather around topics that stimulate real growth and connection. As Executive Director of Nü You Inc., she leads program design, team development, fundraising strategy, and community partnerships to sustain and grow the organization's impact across Baltimore.

With a 10-year background spanning marketing, business, and community building, Gilbryonna has worked with organizations including Morgan Stanley, Consult Lemonade, and The Nü Culture. Her next mission is expanding Nü Momish's services into corporate benefits packages, ensuring every mom and family has access to the village they deserve.

# Calvin Royster

Calvin Royster Jr. is a risk management professional, insurance broker, and business strategist dedicated to helping organizations and entrepreneurs protect what they have built while positioning themselves for sustainable growth. As a leader with Encore Insurance Group, Calvin specializes in commercial insurance, employee benefits, and strategic risk management solutions tailored to businesses, nonprofit organizations, government contractors, and emerging enterprises.

Known for his consultative approach, Calvin believes insurance should be more than a policy—it should be a business asset. He partners with clients to identify operational risks, strengthen their risk management programs, and create customized insurance strategies that support long-term success. His work extends beyond placing coverage, focusing on education, financial awareness, and helping business owners make informed decisions.

A published author and thought leader, Calvin has written multiple educational resources on insurance and financial protection, including Black Millennials Declassified Guide: Survival Guide to Insurance. Through speaking engagements, educational workshops, and digital content, he continues to make complex insurance concepts practical and accessible for business owners and families alike.

Driven by integrity, service, and continuous growth, Calvin is committed to empowering clients with the knowledge and strategies they need to protect their businesses, preserve their wealth, and build lasting legacies.

# Quintel Harcum

**Quintel Harcum** is the Founder of QS Studio, where he builds AI-powered growth systems that help small teams scale their capacity without scaling their overhead. A two-time founder, Quintel specializes in helping established entrepreneurs turn their expertise into founder-led media, content operations, and AI systems that keep working even when they're not in the room.

Quintel's entrepreneurial track record began with Good Part & Co., a health-centric juice bar concept he founded and scaled to two locations in Baltimore. He went on to launch the first juice bar at Johns Hopkins University, becoming the university's first Black food service partner and growing the location to more than $720,000 in revenue.

Since founding QS Studio, Quintel has coached more than 40 businesses on implementing AI systems, helping small teams save time, cut costs, and build owned audiences through smart content and automation. His background spans creative direction, brand strategy, and operations — giving him a rare ability to blend storytelling with systems thinking.

Quintel is based in Baltimore, Maryland.

# Jaren Kirkland

Jaren Kirkland is a businessman with experience in logistics, automotive retail, and finance. He built a last-mile delivery business at 21 that scaled to $5M in annual revenue, alongside owning two auto body franchises each grossing over $1M annually. He recently wound down the logistics business to join Wells Fargo's Mergers & Acquisitions Investment Banking division, building the skill set for his next ventures as a founder and operator.  

# James Busia

**James Busia** is a State Farm® Owner serving the Washington DC-Baltimore area, with 13+ years of experience in insurance and financial services. Since establishing his own agency in 2020, James has achieved Chairman's Circle status in two of his first three years in business — a distinction placing him among the top 10% of the company in production metrics nationwide.

Under his leadership, the agency has grown from $220,000 to $1,000,000 in gross annual revenue, with no cap or ceiling on continued growth. James specializes in marketing strategies and campaigns that connect clients with tailored risk management plans, financial services, and insurance solutions — including property and casualty coverage, disability and long-term care benefits, and loan products.

Prior to founding his agency, James spent seven years as an Independent Agent with State Farm and worked as a Realty Capital Finance Analyst with M\&T Commercial Banking. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Economics from the University of Maryland.

# Erika Baez-Grimes

Erika Baez-Grimes, CM\&AP, is an award-winning M\&A advisor, founder, and dealmaker with more than 15 years of experience leading complex transactions across a range of industries. Her portfolio of companies deliver certified business valuations, transaction strategy, and ownership transition services, guiding founders through critical inflection points in their businesses. Those who know her best call her the Linchpin\!

Her firms have earned a national reputation for achieving premium outcomes for founder-led and family-owned businesses, operating at the intersection of capital, optimization, scale, and exit. Collectively, the companies she’s founded, led, advises or holds ownership interests in have generated more than $350 million in business scale and exit activity. Beyond advisory, Erika holds active LP ownership stakes across multiple industries, giving her a firsthand understanding of what founders stand to gain and lose in any transaction.

That dual perspective has made her one of the most trusted voices at the intersection of dealmaking and economic inclusion. She is recognized for advancing topics like entrepreneurship through acquisition and expanding the ownership conversation in underserved and underrepresented communities.

Erika is a proud member of Entrepreneurs of Purpose, a legacy program of the Enterprising Women Foundation, and several executive leadership organizations, including the world’s largest CEO peer advisory organization. She believes peer advisory is one of the most powerful catalysts for leadership growth, accountability, and long-term business success.

For Erika, the work does not end at the closing table. She contributes to national initiatives focused on pathways to ownership, economic mobility, and youth entrepreneurship, because she believes the next generation of owners is already out there, they just need someone to show them the door.
